def batch_insert(lines, table, cols, rows, batch=25):
    i = 0
    while i < len(rows):
        chunk = rows[i:i + batch]
        lines.append("INSERT INTO %s (%s) VALUES" % (table, cols))
        for j, r in enumerate(chunk):
            sep = "," if j < len(chunk) - 1 else ""
            lines.append(r + sep)
        lines.append("GO")
        lines.append("")
        i += batch
